references.relationship: Master predicate. Wire fraud is the most common §1028A predicate in the enumerated list. The steward's Treasury Securities and crypto fraud cases turn on wire fraud + §1028A coupling.
Civil remedy parallel. FCRA §1681c-2 identity theft block depends on the §1028-defined identity theft concept. FCRA provides the private right of action that §1028 does not.
Civil RICO predicate pathway. §1028 is listed in §1961(1)(B) as a RICO predicate. Civil plaintiffs can use §1028 violations as pattern-of-racketeering predicates under §1964(c).
Companion sentencing enhancement statute. Built as a separate standard but historically and operationally inseparable from §1028.
Privacy Act civil remedy against federal agencies for inaccurate record maintenance. Relevant to Treasury Securities case where Treasury's records are the site of the identity exploitation.
State-law parallel for consumer-protection components of identity theft cases. CLRA reaches deceptive practices; §1028 reaches the criminal identity theft itself. Pled together in civil complaints.

rico_predicate_citation: 18 USC §1961(1)(B) — lists §1028 as RICO predicate offense
